glosses: ticket office, (UK) booking office (an office or booth where tickets may be purchased to allow admittance or for travel, in a train station)
box office (a place where tickets are sold in a theater or cinema)
ticket booth (a small stall for the sale of tickets)

examples.text: Cientos de personas estaban esperando afuera de la taquilla.
examples.en: Hundreds of people were waiting outside the ticket office.

examples.text: Tom encontró un sobre pegado a su taquilla.
examples.en: Tom found an envelope taped to his locker.
